def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    threshold = 0.7 * bins.mean()  # Set a threshold based on average bin capacity
    tightness = 1 / (bins - item + 1e-8)  # Inverse of free space after placing the item (to prefer tight fits)
    proximity = np.abs(bins - threshold)  # Proximity to the threshold (to avoid overflows)
    return tightness - proximity
genes.thought: The algorithm scores each bin based on a weighted combination of how close its remaining capacity is to the item size and how far it is from exceeding a certain threshold, encouraging tight packing while avoiding frequent overflows.
